say.speaker: commander_lairon
say.text: Lower your banners! Goldensand has fallen, and this fortress belongs to Ironscale now.

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Lairon, with Morgrem and Linoone at his side. If this keep falls, the Heartland falls with it.

say.speaker: advisor
say.text: The Royal Guard is on its way. We just have to hold until they get here. Or... beat Lairon first?

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Everyone from the beach on is counting on us. We hold this fortress.
